vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2026-0543
vulnerability.description: chrono is unmaintained (informational advisory; no vulnerability is reported)

statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2026-0543 is an informational advisory that chrono is unmaintained; it reports no vulnerability, and no version is patched. rmcp and arrow/parquet require chrono non-optionally in their newest releases, so it stays in the dependency tree. sipnab's own use of chrono is to be migrated to jiff, the advisory's recommended alternative. Re-evaluate when a vulnerability is reported against chrono or those dependencies drop it.
